comparative_criteria.transverse_wobbling_prediction: Predominantly collective E2 (stretched or mixed Delta I = 1 with large E2 fraction)

comparative_criteria.experimental_fact_135Pr: 813.3 keV polarization P = +0.04(3) and R_DCO = 0.98(5) establish M1 purity >= 96.5% (E2 fraction < 3.5%)

comparative_criteria.experimental_fact_135Pr: Experimental interband E2 crossovers are extremely weak or absent; only B(M1)/B(E2) ~ 15-95 (muN/eb)^2 is extracted

comparative_criteria.transverse_wobbling_prediction: E_wob = E(I, nw=1) - 0.5[E(I+1) + E(I-1)] decreases monotonically with spin (transverse phonon softening)
comparative_criteria.magnetic_rotation_prediction: Energy spacing governed by rotor + shears closure: Delta E_gamma ~ (2I)/J_eff, interrupted by band crossing at hbar*omega ~ 0.37 MeV
comparative_criteria.experimental_fact_135Pr: Band undergoes sharp Coriolis crossing at 31/2- to 33/2- with 6 hbar alignment gain, not a smooth harmonic phonon decrescendo

comparative_criteria.transverse_wobbling_prediction: Rigid or stable triaxial shape (gamma ~ 20-30 deg, beta2 >= 0.16)
comparative_criteria.magnetic_rotation_prediction: Near-spherical or weakly deformed prolate/oblate core (beta2 <= 0.15) to prevent core collective E2 from overwhelming M1
comparative_criteria.experimental_fact_135Pr: Calculated beta2 ~ 0.12-0.15; core quadrupole deformation is moderate, allowing strong M1 shears dominance

synthesis_conclusion: The historical claim of transverse wobbling in 135Pr is refuted by three independent lines of evidence: (1) the 2019 erratum definitively shows the interband decay is >96.5% M1 rather than collective E2; (2) the absence of enhanced B(E2)_out/B(E2)_in signatures; and (3) the high-spin behavior is dictated by a Coriolis 3qp -> 5qp band crossing with shears re-opening, rather than harmonic phonon softening. Therefore, 135Pr Band 3 is firmly classified as Magnetic Rotation.
